==Instructions==
This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Disney+]] and its [https://press.disneyplus.com/ Press website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use. 

<code><nowiki>{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

====Required parameters====
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.disneyplus.com/</nowiki></code> or <code><nowiki>https://www.press.disneyplus.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

====Optional parameters====
*{{Para|subdomain}} The subdomain part of the web page's URL, for example, <code>press</code> (defaults to <code>www</code> if not specified).

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{DisneyPlus|url=series/obi-wan-kenobi/2JYKcHv9fRJb|text=Watch Obi-Wan Kenobi}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{DisneyPlus|url=series/obi-wan-kenobi/2JYKcHv9fRJb|text=Watch Obi-Wan Kenobi}}
